actual_official_semantics.selection: First double-bracket regex match; boxed/single-bracket fallbacks are not used because double brackets exist.
actual_official_semantics.normalization: Strip outer whitespace, then remove double quotes, newlines, spaces and bracket characters from the selected body before rebuilding its wrapper.
actual_official_semantics.comparison: Compare that single normalized first result against the supplied reference answer.

interpretation.observed_case: All complete wrappers contain the same body, so this is repeated delivery of one bracketed answer, not multiple distinct bracketed candidates.
interpretation.limitation: The prior official pass only certifies the official first-answer comparison. This inspection does not establish that the surrounding free text is unambiguous, correct, useful, or free of contradictory statements.
interpretation.future_protocol_suggestion: Predeclare deliverable completeness and unambiguous parsed-answer rules, including repeated identical wrappers, conflicting wrappers and unbounded trailing text. Do not accept arbitrary extractable fragments or any-match candidates.
